subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Rumpelstiltskin's Name
description: Learn Rumpelstiltskin's Name in one minute.

hook.text: A girl must spin straw into gold or die. A strange creature helps—but demands her firstborn child.

buildup.text: She can escape the deal only by guessing his name. Names give power in every magical tradition.

discovery.text: To name something is to understand it. Naming the demon strips its power. Language defeats magic.

twist.text: Rumpelstiltskin tears himself in two when named. The unconscious complex dissolves when made conscious.

climax.text: Therapy works like this: name the pattern and it loses its grip. The Grimms knew this in 1812.

punchline.text: Name your demon. Watch it shatter.
